subject: Re: SDLC evidence — change control, CI/CD IAM, and secrets handling
messages:
From: Elena Morozov <elena.morozov@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-enterprises.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SDLC evidence request: change control + secrets handling

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team is following up with a short list of artifacts and a few clarifying questions as part of our SIG assessment. Can you please provide the following within the next 7 business days?

- High-level change control process (how code and infra changes are requested, reviewed, approved, and deployed)
- Example change request log or ticket export that shows approval history
- CI/CD access matrix and IAM policy for pipeline agents
- How secrets are stored, rotated, and scoped (rotation frequency, vault used, who can access)
- Any CI/CD configuration that enforces peer code review (required approvals)

We don’t need production secrets — just policy, screenshots, and example artifacts. If you can bundle an index PDF with pointers to the specific artifacts, that’d be ideal.

Best,
Elena
Security Intake — Acme Enterprises
[Attachment: acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morozov <elena.morozov@acme-enterprises.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: change control + secrets handling

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Dev (engineering lead for infra) and Neha (security/compliance) so we can assemble a concise package. We’ll prepare:

1) SDLC evidence index (PDF) that maps your bullets to artifacts
2) Change request export (CSV) with redactions as needed
3) CI/CD IAM policy snippet (YAML) for the pipeline service account and SSO bindings
4) Secrets rotation playbook and sample HashiCorp Vault paths (no secrets included)
5) Screenshot of branch protection rules and required reviewers in GitHub

I’ll aim to get a first pass to you by EOD Wed (11/03). If you need faster turnaround on anything specific, please call out priority.

-Monica
Director of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: request-summary.txt (text)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morozov <elena.morozov@acme-enterprises.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: change control + secrets handling

Hi Elena, Monica —

Quick overview of what we’re attaching and a few clarifications:

- change-request-log.csv: Export from Jira (INFRA project) showing request -> review -> approval -> deploy events. Columns: ticket, submitter, reviewers, approver, approval_timestamp, deploy_pipeline_run_id. We will redact customer emails and internal tokens.

- ci_cd_pipeline_iam_policy.yml: Policy for the pipeline service account (shortened). It shows least privilege: only allowed to read artifacts bucket, assume role for ephemeral infra changes with MFA enforced, and no direct access to vault.

- secrets-rotation-playbook.md: Describes our rotation cadence (every 90 days for service credentials, 30 days for DB credentials with automated rotation), who can trigger rotations, and emergency secret-revocation steps.

- branch-protection-screenshot.png (referenced inside the PDF): demonstrates required PR approvals = 2 and status checks.

Notes/questions:
1) For the change-request log, do you want the full ticket text or is summary/metadata sufficient?
2) We will not include production Vault paths; instead we’ll provide example paths and an anonymized audit snippet showing 'read' by a service account. Does that meet your audit team?

If yes, we’ll package and upload to the shared Drive link and send a signed index.

-Dev
Staff Engineering — Infra
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ci_cd_pipeline_iam_policy.yml (YAML)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morozov <elena.morozov@acme-enterprises.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: change control + secrets handling

Elena —

We’ve prepared the evidence bundle and uploaded it to a restricted Drive folder. Highlights:

- sdlc_evidence_index.pdf: maps each ask to the artifact (PDF contains small snippets and links to redacted artifacts).
- change-request-log.csv: redacted export (no customer PII).
- ci_cd_pipeline_iam_policy.yml: shows role bindings and the principle of least privilege for build agents.
- secrets-rotation-playbook.md: includes playbook, emergency steps, and rotation audit snippet from Vault (redacted).
- branch-protection-screenshot.png: shows required reviewer settings in GitHub.

Access: Drive link has view-only access to recipients on this thread. If your team needs a downloadable bundle, we can provide a signed bundle via DocuSign-secured transfer.

Two clarifications for your assessment:
- Change approvals: our change policy requires at least one engineering approver + one security approver for infra-affecting changes. The CSV includes a column for 'security_approval' with timestamps.
- Secrets access: Vault uses namespaced roles and short-lived tokens issued via Vault Agent; service accounts do not possess long-lived credentials. Rotation events and revocations are logged to the audit backend (anonymized snippet attached).

Let us know if you need a walkthrough meeting — Hannah is available if your auditors want to review the artifacts live.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sdlc_evidence_index.pdf (PDF); secrets-rotation-playbook.md (MD)]

From: Elena Morozov <elena.morozov@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-enterprises.com
Date: 2026-11-02T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: change control + secrets handling

Neha/Team —

Thanks — I reviewed the index and a few artifacts. This is exactly what our audit team needed; two quick follow-ups before we close the ticket:

1) On the change-request CSV, can you add a column indicating whether the change required a DB schema migration? Our auditors look for schema-change approvals specifically. If you can add that and re-upload, great.

2) For the Vault audit snippet, can you include the field that shows which principal triggered the rotation (anonymized is fine, but we need the principal->action mapping).

We may schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week — I’ll send a calendar invite if needed. Otherwise, this should be sufficient for our SIG baseline.

Best,
Elena
Security Intake — Acme Enterprises
[Attachment: acme_followup_notes.txt (text)]
